summary.content: Architecte Cloud expérimenté avec plus de 20 ans d'expertise en ingénierie logicielle, infrastructure cloud et automatisation SDLC. Spécialisé dans les initiatives de transformation digitale, les technologies de conteneurisation et les pratiques de déploiement sécurisé. Solide expérience dans le pilotage de projets d'intégration complexes, la mise en œuvre de flux GitOps et la coordination d'équipes pluridisciplinaires. Forte expérience dans les services financiers avec une connaissance approfondie des systèmes back-office et des exigences réglementaires.

items.content:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the CyberSecurity Engineer / DevSecOps position at XXX.

Throughout more than twenty years in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and DevSecOps, I have consistently helped organizations improve their security posture while accelerating software delivery. Rather than viewing security as a gatekeeping function, I focus on building scalable security platforms, automated controls, and engineering practices that enable teams to deliver secure products efficiently.

What particularly attracts me to Wakam is the opportunity to contribute to a technology-driven company that is transforming a highly regulated industry. The challenge of strengthening security while maintaining agility, innovation, and operational excellence aligns perfectly with my professional experience and ambitions.

My background combines enterprise-scale environments such as Thomson Reuters with fast-growing technology companies such as Jus Mundi, where I worked at the intersection of cloud engineering, cybersecurity, compliance, and artificial intelligence. These experiences have given me a broad perspective on how to build security capabilities that support business objectives rather than constrain them.

Over the last 10 years, I have led and implemented numerous initiatives to evolve as CyberSecurity expert, including:

• Designing and deploying SAST, DAST, and SCA programs integrated directly into CI/CD pipelines.

• Establishing automated security controls and security gates while maintaining rapid developer feedback loops.

• Building secure cloud-native platforms using Infrastructure as Code, immutable infrastructure principles, and automated deployment pipelines.

• Embedding security requirements into development workflows through automation, education, and engineering enablement.

• Driving vulnerability management programs focused on risk prioritization and measurable remediation outcomes.

• Supporting compliance initiatives within highly regulated environments, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, and AI governance frameworks such as ISO 42001.

• Securing public-facing applications through Web Application Firewalls (WAF), reverse proxies, traffic filtering, and attack surface reduction strategies.

• Designing and strengthening network security architectures, including segmentation, access control, VPNs, secure communications, and infrastructure hardening.

At Thomson Reuters and later at Jus Mundi, I directly implemented and operationalized SAST, DAST, and SCA capabilities, integrating security testing into engineering workflows and helping teams identify and remediate vulnerabilities early in the software development lifecycle.

At Jus Mundi, I worked extensively on AI-powered legal technology platforms processing large volumes of sensitive legal information. In this environment, security, privacy, compliance, and operational reliability were critical. I collaborated closely with engineering teams, data scientists, legal experts, and executive stakeholders to ensure security was integrated throughout the entire product lifecycle.

My infrastructure experience includes large-scale Linux environments, cloud platforms, Infrastructure as Code, HashiCorp Nomad and Vault, Docker containers, CI/CD automation, monitoring platforms, and production operations. Having worked across development, operations, networking, and security disciplines, I am comfortable addressing security challenges from both application and infrastructure perspectives.

One of my strengths is the ability to bridge the gap between security teams and engineering teams. Security programs succeed when developers understand and adopt them naturally.

What excites me most about this opportunity is not simply operating security tools, but helping Wakam move to the next level of DevSecOps maturity. I am particularly excited by the opportunity to further contribute to the design and deployment of mature SIEM and SOAR capabilities, while supporting the evolution of cloud-native platforms based on Kubernetes and leading cloud providers such as Azure and AWS. I believe my background in DevSecOps, platform engineering, network security, and application security would enable me to quickly deliver value while continuing to broaden my experience in these strategic areas.

For this reason, I see my contribution to Wakam extending beyond the traditional responsibilities of a CyberSecurity Engineer. I believe I can help lead XXX's DevSecOps maturity journey by establishing scalable security foundations, enabling engineering teams, strengthening operational resilience, and aligning security initiatives with business objectives.

Wakam's culture of ownership, continuous improvement, curiosity, and innovation strongly resonates with me. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute my experience and leadership to help build the next generation of secure digital insurance platforms.

Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to discussing how my background in DevSecOps, security engineering, cloud infrastructure, AI platforms and security transformation can support Wakam's continued growth.

Sincerely,
Alban Andrieu
